cards.claim: In his autobiography, director Elia Kazan claimed that Williams was only "half-heartedly" involved in writing the screenplay of the film "Baby Doll", indicating that Elia Kazan directed the film.
cards.quote: the film's title card says "Tennessee Williams' Baby Doll", and the film is based on Williams' one-act play "27 Wagons Full of Cotton", in his autobiography director Elia Kazan claimed that Williams was only "half-heartedly" involved in writing the screenplay, of which Kazan himself actually wrote the majority.
